title: What Earns a Phrase Its Own Token? Mechanistic Multi-Word Vocabulary Allocation, Compositional-Residual Folding, and Test-Time Compute Gearshifting
description: Controlled 34-model Transformer pretraining study (30.4M across 11 tokenizers and 3 paired seeds on 300M unique FineWeb-Edu tokens, scaling zero-shot 5x to 149.6M parameters) investigating multi-word vocabulary allocation. Reveals 33%-37% dead stepping-stone phrase slots in iterative SuperBPE and SupraTok; diagnoses and cures Superword Vote-Splitting via zero-retraining Prefix-Cone Vote Aggregation; introduces Foldable Compositional-Residual Superwords (exact 0.0 float folding error into standard [V, d] lookup tables, #1 out-of-domain generalization, unsupervised idiom discovery); and establishes Attention-Query De-Multiplexing (-51.2% Layer-2 token-stitching attention, 86.81% BLiMP and 39.20% ARC-Easy at 150M) alongside single-checkpoint CoT-free Test-Time Compute Gearshifting (+1.58% accuracy gain).
